---
name: incident-summary
description: Writes a short incident summary with the timeline, the impact, the cause and the follow-ups. Use when asked for a postmortem, an incident write-up or a summary of an outage.
---
# Incident summary

1. Collect what the person already has: alerts, chat excerpts, commits and timestamps.
2. Write the timeline as a short list of times and events, earliest first.
3. State the impact in one sentence: who was affected and for how long.
4. State the cause in one or two sentences, separating what is known from what is guessed.
5. List the follow-ups, each with an owner left blank for the person to fill.
6. Keep the whole summary under one page and show it in the reply.
